items.topic: ACDC #183 与 Glamsterdam 时间线
items.title: ACDT #89 议程
EIP-8141：用于免模拟接纳的规范 P256 发送账户
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。8141 中协议定义、免模拟的接纳路径（默认代码、规范 paymaster、expiry verifier）都只支持 SECP256K1，而 passkey/WebAuthn（secp256r1）钱包在智能账户中占比越来越大；目前 EIP-7702 委托的 P256 账户必须完整模拟验证前缀。PR 增加按运行时代码匹配识别的规范 P256 发送账户，接纳只需代码匹配、一次 `P256VERIFY` 和 scope 检查。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: a canonical P256 sender account for no-simulation admission
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. 8141's protocol-defined no-simulation admission paths (default code, the canonical paymaster, the expiry verifier) are SECP256K1-only, while passkey/WebAuthn (secp256r1) wallets are a large and growing share of smart accounts; today an EIP-7702-delegated P256 account must go through full validation prefix simulation. The PR adds a canonical P256 sender account recognized by runtime code match, admitted with a code match, one `P256VERIFY` and a scope check.

items.title: EIP-8141：允许直接求值协议定义的验证前缀
items.note: （svlachakis）提交。默认代码、规范 expiry verifier 和规范 paymaster 没有需要执行才能发现的部署代码，对只由它们组成的前缀，模拟和直接求值是同一计算；常见流程，即 `self_verify` 的 EOA 式交易和规范 paymaster 代付交易，都属于这一类。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: allow direct evaluation of protocol-defined validation prefixes
items.note_en: (svlachakis), submitted. Default code, the canonical expiry verifier and the canonical paymaster have no deployed code to discover by execution, so for prefixes made only of them, simulation and direct evaluation are the same computation; the common flows, `self_verify` EOA-style transactions and canonical-paymaster-sponsored transactions, fall into this class.

items.title: EIP-8141：规定 APPROVE 操作码的 gas 成本
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交，`APPROVE`（`0xaa`）是唯一未规定 gas 的新 frame 操作码；在静态约束中限制费用字段（svlachakis）提交，RLP 允许任意长整数，而 `TXPARAM` 会把费用字段压栈，超出栈字宽度。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: specify the APPROVE opcode gas cost
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted, since `APPROVE` (`0xaa`) was the only new frame opcode without a gas cost; bound the fee fields in the static constraints (svlachakis), submitted, since RLP admits arbitrarily long integers while `TXPARAM` pushes fee fields onto the stack, where they might not fit a stack word.

items.title: 在静态约束中限制费用字段
items.note: EIP-8141：规定 APPROVE 操作码的 gas 成本（AnkushinDaniil）提交，`APPROVE`（`0xaa`）是唯一未规定 gas 的新 frame 操作码；在静态约束中限制费用字段（svlachakis）提交，RLP 允许任意长整数，而 `TXPARAM` 会把费用字段压栈，超出栈字宽度。
items.title_en: bound the fee fields in the static constraints
items.note_en: EIP-8141: specify the APPROVE opcode gas cost (AnkushinDaniil), submitted, since `APPROVE` (`0xaa`) was the only new frame opcode without a gas cost; bound the fee fields in the static constraints (svlachakis), submitted, since RLP admits arbitrarily long integers while `TXPARAM` pushes fee fields onto the stack, where they might not fit a stack word.

items.title: 新 EIP：离线状态迁移到 PBT
items.note: （misilva73）提交，据 Ethereal news #32 编号 EIP-8347：在最终确定的锚点区块把状态从十六进制 MPT 离线转换为 Partitioned Binary Tree（EIP-8297），以可验证快照分发，节点用锚点 `stateRoot` 校验，再通过回放 BAL（EIP-7928）追上链头。
items.title_en: New EIP: offline state migration to the PBT
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted; per Ethereal news #32 it is numbered EIP-8347. State at a finalized anchor block is converted offline from the hexary MPT to the Partitioned Binary Tree (EIP-8297) and distributed as a verifiable snapshot; nodes verify it against the anchor's `stateRoot` and catch up to the tip by replaying BALs (EIP-7928).

keywords_en: first public testnet targeted for September
EIP-8141 canonical P256 sender account and passkeys
direct evaluation of protocol-defined validation prefixes
summary_en: Per Ethereal news #32, ACDC #183 set devnet-8 for early August with minor repricing changes and discv5-only execution layer discovery, devnet-9 for August non-finality testing, and the first public testnet for September; new Hegotá proposals include EIP-8334, EIP-8341, EIP-8321 and EIP-8015. Four EIP-8141 changes were submitted: a canonical P256 sender account that lets passkey accounts enter the mempool without simulation, direct evaluation of protocol-defined validation prefixes, the APPROVE gas cost, and bounds on fee fields. misilva73 submitted an EIP for offline state migration to the PBT.
